reviews.reason: Thirty exact-format Top 10 searches were recorded and two final selections retained candidate-bound mappings across two distinct ranks. This does not prove the search process improved reader outcomes.
Runtime declarations were preserved; scheduler identity, host identity, usage and billing origin remain unknown rather than inferred.
Fifteen complete dated-item reads were recorded separately from 182 bounded index scans. The shortfall field is not applicable because the advisory minimum was met.
Seventeen substantive non-news programs across twelve publisher families were reviewed; two final programs and two ordered reserves passed protected signed-out playback, with zero news selections.

The compiler published a verified six-story PUBLISHED_PENDING handoff and generated no premium images. First-pass accepts, native calls, saved-pixel margin corrections and distinct visual styles remain unknown until the separate image receipt exists.
Eight Watchlist leads across eight source families produced zero fabricated 85+ scores, one supported material update and an explicit protein-design evidence gap.
A qualified original quantum research report with machine-checkable result descriptions was fully reviewed; the one-in-three advisory cadence was met.
Live reader publication, pending image lifecycle, Top 10 mapping, protected recovery and unknown runtime/usage evidence are reported separately.

production_quality_conclusion: Implementation and gate completion are not proof of better reader or production outcomes; later interaction, image and longitudinal evidence are still required.
